name: Magick++
reason: C++ API layer of ImageMagick (Magick++/ directory in ImageMagick/ImageMagick). Project and README make no speed claim. No shootout row exercises Magick++ by name. Best reachable data: libvips Speed-and-memory-use wiki (Threadripper PRO 3955WX, Ubuntu 25.04, run 12 Aug 2025; load/crop/shrink/sharpen/save of a 10000x10000 TIFF) shows ImageMagick 7.1.1 convert/magick at 4.44 s/4.41 s versus libvips 0.57 s, GraphicsMagick 2.05 s, OpenCV 3.15 s, i.e. ImageMagick slower than every fast incumbent; the only baselines it edges are FreeImage 4.65 s, libgd 5.47 s, netpbm 6.06 s, G'MIC 11.63 s, Octave 35.1 s, and nobody claims that as a win. Not recorded.

name: MagickWand
reason: C API layer of ImageMagick (MagickWand/ directory in ImageMagick/ImageMagick). No speed claim by the project. Only incidental number: libvips vips-bench row imwand.py (Python Wand binding over MagickWand, ImageMagick 7.1.1) takes 4.33 s on the wiki's 10000x10000 TIFF crop/shrink/sharpen/save test versus libvips 0.57 s, GraphicsMagick 2.05 s, OpenCV 3.15 s, Pillow-SIMD 1.51 s; it only edges FreeImage 4.65 s, libgd 5.47 s, netpbm 6.06 s, G'MIC 11.63 s, Octave 35.1 s, and the page is a libvips-authored comparison that presents ImageMagick as slow. No win claimed by anyone. Not recorded.

name: Maximilian
listed_description: C++ Audio and Music DSP Library.
reason: README, repo page and docs list features only; no benchmark, speed claim or comparison with STK, JUCE, Faust or Web Audio nodes. WebSearch found the Goldsmiths 'Write once run anywhere revisited' paper (asm.js via Emscripten) and the ICLC 2024 maximilian.js paper; their hosts (eprints-gro.gold.ac.uk, ualresearchonline.arts.ac.uk) were unreachable (ENOTFOUND) and search snippets show no performance numbers.

name: MediaInfoLib
listed_description: Convenient unified display of the most relevant technical and tag data for video and audio files.
reason: README is a licence stub (BSD-2-Clause) with no speed claim. WebSearch found only anecdotes (ffprobe slow for 1000+ files versus exiftool, FFmpeg trac #7381) with no MediaInfo timings and no benchmark against ffprobe or exiftool. No numeric comparison reachable.

name: miniaudio
listed_description: Single file audio playback and capture library.
reason: Repo page (7.4k stars, public domain or MIT-0) and miniaudio.h comments make no speed claim against libsamplerate, SDL_mixer, PortAudio or libFLAC; header grep for 'faster than', 'benchmark', 'libsamplerate' found nothing. Two WebSearch queries found no third-party miniaudio benchmark (only a quality issue #286 and resampler comparisons that omit miniaudio). No numeric comparison reachable.
